what: A shallow arc painted in the next section’s color (bow shape, high at both ends and touching the bottom in the middle, 1280:66 aspect) is laid along the section’s bottom (or top) edge, and when the arc enters the 80% line of the screen it grows once from height 0 to its full height over .6s power2.out — the hero arc grows as soon as the page opens. Sections join with a soft curve instead of a straight line

options.edge: bottom (default) — attached under the section with the bottom as axis · top attaches above the section with the top as axis (arc where the previous section color comes down)
options.now: When true, grows as soon as it opens without waiting for scroll (Hero arc)
options.--fx-arc: Arc color (css variable) — default var(--kf-bg). Sets the background color of the next section

from.where: index.html·recruit.html·detail.html .c-arc / .c-reverseArc — a lower arc per section (the next section’s blue stage), the Hero arc shows right away as c-arc--first
